Kaniv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Cherkasy Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Classified as demolished, yet this cemetery's own condition notes describe most of the grounds as well-maintained and fenced — another contradiction in the source data worth flagging rather than resolving. Its oldest tombstone dates to the early 20th century, though it first appears on maps only from 1941; the ESJF fenced the site in July 2015. In an unusual twist, local authorities appear to have tried clearing vegetation with fire, leaving burned pine trees around the grounds, one of which has fallen onto the cemetery wall.
